name: Andaz London Liverpool Street
positioning: Andaz lifestyle hotel in a late-1800s redbrick railway hotel above Liverpool Street Station, on the eastern edge of the City of London, mixing Victorian and modern design
best_for: Travelers who want a base directly above Liverpool Street Station, between the City and East London
Design-minded guests drawn to Victorian heritage with modern interiors
Families who want interconnected rooms, and travelers with cats or dogs

facts.text: Liverpool Street station gives access to the Central, Circle, Elizabeth, Hammersmith and City and Metropolitan lines and the London Overground.
The hotel's design is a mix of Victorian and modern.
Rooms and suites reflect the hotel's location, history and heritage, where the traditional City meets the artistic vibe of East London.
The Andaz Design Suite has Eames and Karuselli chairs, a Savoir bed and a replica of the coffee table Conran designed for his own home.
Rooms have a complimentary minibar with snacks and non-alcoholic beverages.
The Family Room is two interconnected rooms with two bathrooms.
Family Rooms include an Andaz London colouring kit, a teddy bear and a chalkboard easel.
Rake's Cafe Bar has live sets from resident DJs every Thursday, Friday and Saturday evening.
Miyako serves sushi, sashimi, teriyaki and sake in an intimate, contemporary setting.
Pets are welcome, with toys, treats, plush beds and feeding bowls for cats and dogs in the room.
The historic building has wedding and event spaces with modern and classic Victorian interiors.

highlights.text: The property has a hidden Masonic temple, reached through a heavy studded door and a winding staircase.
The Andaz Design Suite is by British designer Sir Terence Conran, with interiors inspired by East London's heritage and culture.
The two-wing redbrick hotel was built in the late 1800s by the Great Eastern Railway Company and sits on the eastern fringe of the City, London's financial district.
London Liverpool Street Station is directly above the hotel.
The Deluxe Fitness Equipped king room has a Peloton bike, dumbbells and yoga equipment.

considerations.text: The hotel does not provide on-site parking; paid self parking is available nearby.
Many room types look over either the city or the interior gallery, so the view varies.
WhataHotel notes the busy transport hub location can be noisy.
